sections.title: VIPER Independent Study
sections.description: This course evaluates the performance of student researchers who enter into Penn campus laboratories or working groups through the supervision of the Vagelos Integrated Program in Energy Research (VIPER). VIPER is a dual degree program in which enrolled undergraduate students pursue joint degrees in science and engineering and complete ongoing, cumulative research experiences related to alternative energy under the supervision of Penn faculty with appointments in science and engineering. The goal of VIPR 399 is 1) to evaluate the quality of student performance as they become involved in a Penn lab or research group that is active in scientific or engineering fields related to sustainable energy; and 2) to evaluate the quality of student scientific writing as based on this research experience.
